dedupe_keys.name: national power portal npp india capacity daily generation transmission and coal stock information for the indian power sector

description: The National Power Portal is a unified system for the Indian power sector, built by the National Informatics Centre as one of its e-governance projects with the Central Electricity Authority as nodal agency. It captures daily, monthly and annual data from generation and transmission utilities and disseminates operational, capacity, demand, supply and consumption information as reports, graphs and statistics at all-India, regional and state level for central, state and private sectors, with a GIS-enabled dashboard. On the day of cataloguing the home page showed all-India installed capacity for September 2026 by nuclear, hydro, thermal and renewable sources, daily generation by source for 24 September 2026 including imports from Bhutan, transmission lines and transformation capacity at 220 kV and above, and daily coal stock, receipt and consumption as of 25 September 2026. The Hindi page adds that the portal automates data collection across generation, transmission and distribution and supports monitoring of aggregate technical and commercial losses. Logged-in modules include the national power database management system and DRIPS, a disaster resource inventory for the power sector. Coverage is India. Public pages are free; no data licence is stated. Caveats: data are entered by utilities, and the database and disaster inventory modules are behind a login. Simulation uses are Indian capacity, generation and fuel stock series for adequacy and supply disruption studies. Related records: data-india-power-supply-position-daily-reports gives Grid-India daily reports.
